texto.es: Llama o pasa por el taller en 999 W Flagler St y nos cuentas qué le pasa a tu carro, sin cita previa.
texto.en: Call or stop by the shop at 999 W Flagler St and tell us what is going on with your car, no appointment needed.

texto.es: Revisamos el carro y te explicamos qué necesita de verdad, antes de tocar nada.
texto.en: We check the car and explain what it actually needs, before touching anything.

texto.es: Frenos, aceite, llantas, A/C o tune up: el trabajo se hace en el mismo taller, con las piezas que tu carro necesita.
texto.en: Brakes, oil, tires, A/C or tune up: the work happens right here at the shop, with the parts your car needs.

texto.es: Revisamos que todo quede funcionando antes de entregarte las llaves, a un precio más bajo que el dealer.
texto.en: We make sure everything works before handing you back the keys, at a lower price than the dealer.

nota.es: Cambio de aceite y frenos a precio fijo, el mismo que ves afuera del taller. El resto se cotiza según el carro: llama y te damos el detalle.
nota.en: Oil changes and brakes at a fixed price, the same one posted outside the shop. Everything else is quoted based on your car: call us and we will walk you through it.

texto.es: Cambio de aceite con aceite de calidad, al precio que ves puesto afuera del taller.
texto.en: Oil change with quality oil, at the same price posted right outside the shop.

texto.es: Pastillas, discos y limpieza del sistema de frenos, al precio que publicamos en el taller.
texto.en: Pads, rotors and a full brake system clean, at the price posted at the shop.

texto.es: Venta de llantas nuevas y usadas, ponche y rotación de gomas. Te asesoramos según tu presupuesto.
texto.en: New and used tire sales, flat repair and tire rotation. We help you choose based on your budget.

texto.es: Mecánicos certificados para el aire acondicionado, el tune up y el diagnóstico computarizado de tu carro.
texto.en: Certified mechanics for your car's A/C, tune up and computer diagnostics.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Llama al taller, seguro lo resolvemos.
pie.en: Don't see what you need? Call the shop, we can probably help.

items.quote: They do everything very well and regularly. I changed the brakes and discs of my car. They oiled and cleaned the brakes and discs. They work very well. Thank you very much for everything.
Just moved to Miami. Very nice and helpful people. They'll probably be our go-to mechanic in town.

Had a great experience with Hector! My side mirror broke, and they were able to source a replacement and install it quickly and most importantly all at a fraction of the cost that the dealer quoted me. Super friendly, efficient, and affordable. Highly recommend!
